test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: On 22April 2019, Ministry of AYUSH signed a MoU with which of the following organisations to promote research and education in traditional system of medicine and its integration with modern science?
solution:
The correct answer is __**CSIR.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• The Ministry of AYUSH and the **Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR)**, New Delhi, signed a **Memorandum of Understanding** (MOU) for research and education in traditional systems of medicine and its integration with modern science.
 
• In the presence of top officials from both organisations, **Vaidya Rajesh Kotecha**, former secretary, Ministry of AYUSH, and **Dr. Shekhar C. Mande,** Director General, CSIR and Secretary, DSIR, signed the MoU.
 
• Previously, the CSIR and the Department of Ayush (now the Ministry) collaborated to create the **Traditional Knowledge Digital Library** (TKDL), a worldwide known proprietary database on **Indian medical systems** aimed at combating **bio-piracy and misuse.**
